source: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early. (2022 revision, pages updated 2026-05)
definition: Developmental milestones are things most children (75% or more) can do by a certain age.

meta.page_last_reviewed: May 16, 2026 (milestone pages); Jun 2025 - Feb 2026 (Milestones in Action pages)
fetch_notes: 9 of 12 milestone pages returned the four milestone sections directly.

4mo, 6mo, 18mo: milestone accordion sections were not rendered by the reader on the main pages (multiple retries); milestone text taken from CDC 'Milestones in Action' pages for the same ages, which list the identical current milestone wording per development area.

12mo: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/12-months.html consistently returned fetcher network errors; the variant https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html loads but its milestone accordion did not render either, so milestone text was taken from https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones-in-action/1-year.html.
doctor_discussion: What are some things you and your child do together?
What are some things your child likes to do?
Is there anything your child does or does not do that concerns you?
Has your child lost any skills he/she once had?
Does your child have any special healthcare needs or was he/she born prematurely?

social_emotional: Calms down when spoken to or picked up
Looks at your face
Seems happy to see you when you walk up to her
Smiles when you talk to or smile at her
language_communication: Makes sounds other than crying
Reacts to loud sounds
cognitive: Watches you as you move
Looks at a toy for several seconds
movement_physical: Holds head up when on tummy
Moves both arms and both legs
Opens hands briefly
social_emotional_zh: 别人和他/她说话或者抱起他/她时，他/她会安静下来
他/她会看着你的脸
当你走近他/她时，他/她看起来很高兴
当你和他/她说话或者对他/她微笑时，他/她会笑
language_communication_zh: 除了哭声之外，他/她还会发出其他声音
他/她会对外界的大声有反应
cognitive_zh: 他/她会看着你移动
他/她会盯着一个玩具看几秒钟
movement_physical_zh: 他/她能在肚子上的时候把头抬起来
他/她能同时移动双臂和双腿
他/她能短暂地张开手

social_emotional: Smiles on his own to get your attention
Chuckles (not yet a full laugh) when you try to make him laugh
Looks at you, moves, or makes sounds to get or keep your attention
language_communication: Makes sounds like “oooo”, “aahh” (cooing)
Makes sounds back when you talk to him
Turns head towards the sound of your voice
cognitive: If hungry opens mouth when she sees breast or bottle
Looks at her hands with interest
movement_physical: Holds head steady without support when you are holding him
Holds a toy when you put it in his hand
Uses his arm to swing at toys
Brings hands to mouth
Pushes up onto elbows/forearms when on tummy
social_emotional_zh: 自己微笑来吸引你的注意
当你试图逗他笑时，他会咯咯笑（还不是大笑）
看着你、移动或发出声音来吸引或保持你的注意
language_communication_zh: 发出像“oooo”、“aahh”这样的声音（咿咿呀呀）
当你和他说话时，他会发出声音回应
把头转向你声音的方向
cognitive_zh: 如果饿了，看到奶瓶或乳房时会张开嘴
好奇地看自己的手
movement_physical_zh: 在你抱着他的时候，能够稳稳地保持头部不晃动
当你把玩具放进他手里时，他会握住玩具
用他的手臂挥动玩具
把双手放到嘴里
在肚子上时能够用手肘或前臂支撑起身体

social_emotional: Knows familiar people
Likes to look at self in a mirror
Laughs
language_communication: Takes turns making sounds with you
Blows “raspberries” (sticks tongue out and blows)
Makes squealing noises
cognitive: Puts things in her mouth to explore them
Reaches to grab a toy she wants
Closes lips to show she doesn’t want more food
movement_physical: Rolls from tummy to back
Pushes up with straight arms when on tummy
Leans on hands to support herself when sitting
social_emotional_zh: 认识熟悉的人
喜欢在镜子前看自己
会笑
language_communication_zh: 能和你轮流发出声音
会吹泡泡（伸出舌头吹气）
会发出尖锐的声音
cognitive_zh: 会把东西放进嘴里探索
会伸手抓他想要的玩具
会闭上嘴唇表示不想再吃食物
movement_physical_zh: 能从肚子朝后翻滚
在肚子上时能伸直手臂支撑身体
坐着时能用手支撑自己

social_emotional: Is shy, clingy, or fearful around strangers
Shows several facial expressions, like happy, sad, angry, and surprised
Looks when you call her name
Reacts when you leave (looks, reaches for you, or cries)
Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo
language_communication: Makes a lot of different sounds like “mamamama” and “bababababa”
Lifts arms up to be picked up
cognitive: Looks for objects when dropped out of sight (like his spoon or toy)
Bangs two things together
movement_physical: Gets to a sitting position by herself
Moves things from one hand to her other hand
Uses fingers to “rake” food towards himself
Sits without support
social_emotional_zh: 孩子见到陌生人可能会害羞、黏人或害怕
孩子能表现出多种面部表情，比如开心、伤心、生气和惊讶
当叫孩子的名字时，他会看向你
当你要离开时，孩子会做出反应（比如看、伸手或哭泣）
和孩子玩捉迷藏时，孩子会笑或笑出声
language_communication_zh: 孩子会发出很多不同的声音，比如‘妈妈妈妈’和‘爸爸爸爸’
孩子会举起手想要被抱起来
cognitive_zh: 孩子会寻找看不见的物品（比如他的勺子或玩具）
孩子会敲打两样东西
movement_physical_zh: 孩子能自己坐起来
孩子能将物品从一只手移动到另一只手
孩子会用手指把食物‘耙’向自己
孩子能不用支撑自己坐着

social_emotional: Plays games with you, like pat-a-cake
language_communication: Waves “bye-bye”
Calls a parent “mama” or “dada” or another special name
Understands “no” (pauses briefly or stops when you say it)
cognitive: Puts something in a container, like a block in a cup
Looks for things he sees you hide, like a toy under a blanket
movement_physical: Pulls up to stand
Walks, holding on to furniture
Drinks from a cup without a lid, as you hold it
Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food
social_emotional_zh: 喜欢和你一起玩，比如拍手游戏
language_communication_zh: 挥手说‘再见’
能叫‘妈妈’、‘爸爸’或者其他的特别名字
能理解‘不’的意思，当你这么说的时候会短暂地停下来或者停止动作
cognitive_zh: 能将东西放入容器中，比如把积木放入杯子
能寻找你藏起来的东西，比如在毯子下的玩具
movement_physical_zh: 能自己站起来
能扶着家具走路
能不用盖子的杯子喝水，当你拿着它的时候
能用拇指和食指捏起东西，比如小块食物

social_emotional: Copies other children while playing, like taking toys out of a container when another child does
Shows you an object she likes
Claps when excited
Hugs stuffed doll or other toy
Shows you affection (hugs, cuddles, or kisses you)
language_communication: Tries to say one or two words besides “mama” or “dada,” like “ba” for ball or “da” for dog
Looks at a familiar object when you name it
Follows directions given with both a gesture and words. For example, he gives you a toy when you hold out your hand and say, “Give me the toy.”
Points to ask for something or to get help
cognitive: Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book
Stacks at least two small objects, like blocks
movement_physical: Takes a few steps on his own
Uses fingers to feed herself some food
social_emotional_zh: 模仿其他孩子玩耍，比如当另一个孩子从容器里拿出玩具时，他也这么做
向你展示他喜欢的物品
兴奋时会拍手
拥抱毛绒玩具或其他玩具
向你表达爱意（拥抱、抱抱或亲吻你）
language_communication_zh: 尝试说出除了“妈妈”或“爸爸”之外的一个或两个词，比如用“ba”指球，用“da”指狗
当你说出熟悉物品的名字时，他会看向那个物品
跟随带有手势和言语的指示。例如，当你伸出手说“给我玩具”时，他会给你玩具
指向某物以请求或寻求帮助
cognitive_zh: 尝试正确使用物品，比如手机、杯子或书本
至少堆叠两个小物品，比如积木
movement_physical_zh: 自己走几步
用手指给自己喂食一些食物

social_emotional: Moves away from you, but looks to make sure you are close by
Points to show you something interesting
Puts hands out for you to wash them
Looks at a few pages in a book with you
Helps you dress him by pushing arm through sleeve or lifting up foot
language_communication: Tries to say three or more words besides “mama” or “dada”
Follows one-step directions without any gestures, like giving you the toy when you say, “Give it to me.”
cognitive: Copies you doing chores, like sweeping with a broom
Plays with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car
movement_physical: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything
Scribbles
Drinks from a cup without a lid and may spill sometimes
Feeds himself with his fingers
Tries to use a spoon
Climbs on and off a couch or chair without help
social_emotional_zh: 孩子会离开你，但会看看你还在附近
孩子会指着东西给你看，表示有趣的事物
孩子会伸出双手让你帮他洗手
孩子会和你一起翻看几页书
孩子会帮你穿衣服，比如把胳膊伸进袖子里或者抬起脚
language_communication_zh: 孩子会尝试说三个或更多的单词，除了‘妈妈’或‘爸爸’
孩子会按照你的一个简单指令做，比如你说‘给我’，他就把玩具递给你，不需要任何手势
cognitive_zh: 孩子会模仿你做家务，比如拿着扫帚扫地
孩子会用简单的玩法玩玩具，比如推玩具车
movement_physical_zh: 孩子可以不用抓着人或物自己走路
孩子会乱涂乱画
孩子可以不用盖子喝杯子里的水，有时可能会洒出来
孩子会用手指自己吃东西
孩子会尝试使用勺子
孩子可以不用帮忙就爬上爬下沙发或椅子

social_emotional: Notices when others are hurt or upset, like pausing or looking sad when someone is crying
Looks at your face to see how to react in a new situation
language_communication: Points to things in a book when you ask, like “Where is the bear?”
Says at least two words together, like “More milk.”
Points to at least two body parts when you ask him to show you
Uses more gestures than just waving and pointing, like blowing a kiss or nodding yes
cognitive: Holds something in one hand while using the other hand; for example, holding a container and taking the lid off
Tries to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy
Plays with more than one toy at the same time, like putting toy food on a toy plate
movement_physical: Kicks a ball
Runs
Walks (not climbs) up a few stairs with or without help
Eats with a spoon
social_emotional_zh: 注意到别人受伤或难过，比如看到有人哭时会停下来或看起来很难过
在遇到新情况时，会看着你的脸来了解如何反应
language_communication_zh: 当你问‘熊在哪里’时，会指着书里的东西
能说出至少两个词组合的话，比如‘更多牛奶’
当你让他指给你看时，能指至少两个身体部位
比只是挥手和指点的手势更多，比如吹个飞吻或点头表示‘是’
cognitive_zh: 一只手拿着东西，另一只手做其他事情；比如拿着一个容器，打开盖子
会尝试使用玩具上的开关、旋钮或按钮
能同时玩多个玩具，比如把玩具食物放在玩具盘子上
movement_physical_zh: 能踢球
能跑
在帮助或不需要帮助的情况下，能走上几级楼梯（不是爬）
能用勺子吃饭

social_emotional: Plays next to other children and sometimes plays with them
Shows you what she can do by saying, “Look at me!”
Follows simple routines when told, like helping to pick up toys when you say, “It’s clean-up time.”
language_communication: Says about 50 words
Says two or more words together, with one action word, like “Doggie run”
Names things in a book when you point and ask, “What is this?”
Says words like “I,” “me,” or “we”
cognitive: Uses things to pretend, like feeding a block to a doll as if it were food
Shows simple problem-solving skills, like standing on a small stool to reach something
Follows two-step instructions like “Put the toy down and close the door.”
Shows he knows at least one color, like pointing to a red crayon when you ask, “Which one is red?”
movement_physical: Uses hands to twist things, like turning doorknobs or unscrewing lids
Takes some clothes off by himself, like loose pants or an open jacket
Jumps off the ground with both feet
Turns book pages, one at a time, when you read to her
social_emotional_zh: 能和其他孩子并排玩耍，有时也会和他们一起玩
通过说‘看我这！’来展示他能做什么
当你告诉他‘现在是收拾玩具的时间’时，他会按照简单的日常安排行动，比如帮忙收拾玩具
language_communication_zh: 能说大约50个单词
能说出两个或更多的词组，其中包含一个动作词，比如‘狗狗跑’
当你指着书中的物品并问‘这是什么？’时，他能说出物品的名字
能说出‘我’、‘我’或‘我们’这样的词
cognitive_zh: 会用东西假装，比如把积木喂给娃娃，就像它是食物一样
表现出简单的解决问题的能力，比如站在小凳子上够东西
能按照两步指令行动，比如‘放下玩具，关上门’
能识别至少一种颜色，比如当你问‘哪个是红色的？’时，他能指着红色的蜡笔
movement_physical_zh: 会用手拧东西，比如转动门把手或拧开瓶盖
能自己脱掉一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子或开着的夹克
能双脚同时跳离地面
当你给他读书时，能一次翻一页书

social_emotional: Calms down within 10 minutes after you leave her, like at a childcare drop off
Notices other children and joins them to play
language_communication: Talks with you in conversation using at least two back-and-forth exchanges
Asks “who,” “what,” “where,” or “why” questions, like “Where is mommy/daddy?”
Says what action is happening in a picture or book when asked, like “running,” “eating,” or “playing”
Says first name, when asked
Talks well enough for others to understand, most of the time
cognitive: Draws a circle, when you show him how
Avoids touching hot objects, like a stove, when you warn her
movement_physical: Strings items together, like large beads or macaroni
Puts on some clothes by himself, like loose pants or a jacket
Uses a fork
social_emotional_zh: 离开他/她10分钟内就能平静下来，比如在幼儿园接送时
注意到其他孩子并加入他们的游戏
language_communication_zh: 能和你进行对话，至少有两次你来我往的交流
会问“谁”、“什么”、“哪里”或“为什么”这类问题，比如“妈妈/爸爸在哪里？”
当被问到时，能说出图片或书中的动作，比如“跑步”、“吃饭”或“玩耍”
当被问到时，能说出自己的名字
大多数时候，他/她说话足够清楚，别人能听懂
cognitive_zh: 在你教他/她的时候，能画出圆形
当你警告他/她时，会避免触摸热的东西，比如炉子
movement_physical_zh: 能将物品串在一起，比如大珠子或通心粉
能自己穿上一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子或夹克
会用叉子

social_emotional: Pretends to be something else during play (teacher, superhero, dog)
Asks to go play with children if none are around, like “Can I play with Alex?”
Comforts others who are hurt or sad, like hugging a crying friend
Avoids danger, like not jumping from tall heights at the playground
Likes to be a “helper”
Changes behavior based on where she is (place of worship, library, playground)
language_communication: Says sentences with four or more words
Says some words from a song, story, or nursery rhyme
Talks about at least one thing that happened during her day, like “I played soccer.”
Answers simple questions like “What is a coat for?” or “What is a crayon for?”
cognitive: Names a few colors of items
Tells what comes next in a well-known story
Draws a person with three or more body parts
movement_physical: Catches a large ball most of the time
Serves herself food or pours water, with adult supervision
Unbuttons some buttons
Holds crayon or pencil between fingers and thumb (not a fist)
social_emotional_zh: 玩的时候假装成别人（比如老师、超级英雄、狗）
如果周围没有其他孩子，会主动要求去和其他孩子玩，比如‘我能和Alex一起玩吗？’
会安慰受伤或难过的其他孩子，比如拥抱一个正在哭泣的朋友
会避开危险，比如不会从很高的地方跳下来
喜欢当‘帮手’
根据所在的地方改变自己的行为（比如在教堂、图书馆、游乐场）
language_communication_zh: 能说由四个或更多单词组成的句子
能说出歌曲、故事或儿歌中的某些单词
能谈论当天至少发生的一件事，比如‘我踢足球了。’
能回答简单的问题，比如‘外套是用来干什么的？’或‘蜡笔是用来干什么的？’
cognitive_zh: 能说出几个物品的颜色
能说出一个已知故事的下一部分
能画出有三个或更多身体部位的人
movement_physical_zh: 大多数时候能接住一个大球
在成人监督下能自己吃饭或倒水
能解开一些扣子
能用手指和拇指握住蜡笔或铅笔（不是用拳头）

social_emotional: Follows rules or takes turns when playing games with other children
Sings, dances, or acts for you
Does simple chores at home, like matching socks or clearing the table after eating
language_communication: Tells a story she heard or made up with at least two events. For example, a cat was stuck in a tree and a firefighter saved it
Answers simple questions about a book or story after you read or tell it to him
Keeps a conversation going with more than three back-and-forth exchanges
Uses or recognizes simple rhymes (bat-cat, ball-tall)
cognitive: Counts to 10
Names some numbers between 1 and 5 when you point to them
Uses words about time, like “yesterday,” “tomorrow,” “morning,” or “night”
Pays attention for 5 to 10 minutes during activities. For example, during story time or making arts and crafts (screen time does not count)
Writes some letters in her name
Names some letters when you point to them
movement_physical: Buttons some buttons
Hops on one foot
social_emotional_zh: 和其他孩子玩游戏时，能遵守规则或轮流玩
为你唱歌、跳舞或表演
能在家做简单的家务，比如整理袜子或吃饭后清理桌子
language_communication_zh: 能讲述听到的或自己编的故事，故事中至少有两个事件。例如，一只猫被困在树上，消防员救了它
你读完或讲完一个故事后，能回答关于故事或书中的简单问题
能进行超过三个来回的对话
能使用或识别简单的押韵词，比如‘bat-cat’、‘ball-tall’
cognitive_zh: 能数到10
当你指向1到5之间的数字时，能说出一些数字
能使用关于时间的词汇，比如‘昨天’、‘明天’、‘早上’或‘晚上’
在进行活动时能集中注意力5到10分钟。例如，在讲故事或做手工艺品时（屏幕时间不算在内）
能写出自己名字中的一些字母
当你指向字母时，能说出一些字母
movement_physical_zh: 能扣一些扣子
能单脚跳
